steps.en: Officer clicks a notice and its details open
steps.id: Officer meng-klik notice dan detailnya terbuka

steps.en: Details show the owner or hirer particulars
steps.id: Detail menampilkan particulars owner atau hirer
steps.why_en: Only the submitter's particulars show; the notice's registered owner, hirer and driver details are hidden on this screen.
steps.why_id: Hanya particulars submitter yang tampil; data owner, hirer, dan driver terdaftar pada notice disembunyikan di layar ini.

steps.en: Details show the hirer/driver particulars that were furnished
steps.id: Detail menampilkan particulars hirer/driver yang di-furnish

steps.en: Details list the documentary proof submitted
steps.id: Detail mencantumkan documentary proof yang disubmit

steps.en: Officer can download the proof, one file or all as a zip
steps.id: Officer dapat mengunduh bukti, satu file atau semua sebagai zip
